item.title: Kutztown University Recognizes Schuylkill County Students on Fall 2025 Dean’s List
item.description: Kutztown University has announced that 2,261 students were named to its Fall 2025 Dean’s List including dozens from Schuylkill County.To qualify for the Dean’s List, an undergraduate student must be registered for at least 12 credit hours and earn a minimum grade point average of 3.60. Among those honored are dozens of students from Schuylkill County and the surrounding region, reflecting the area’s strong representation at the university. item.description: POTTSVILLE — Pottsville Police are searching for a 44-year-old Allentown man wanted in connection with a violent early-morning incident that occurred on Thursday, January 8, 2026, at a residence in the city. item.title: Shenandoah Man Convicted in Schuylkill County Trial on Child Sexual Abuse Material Charges
item.description: A Schuylkill County man has been convicted following a jury trial on charges related to possession of child sexual abuse material. A Schuylkill County jury found Antony Cuff, 47, of Shenandoah, guilty of 17 felony counts of possession of child sexual abuse material and one felony count of criminal use of a communication facility.
